tool_schemas.name: fetch_f1_calendar
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored Formula 1 season calendar for the specified year, including races/events and their sessions, as a single dictionary (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if year is missing or not a valid year string, and NOT_FOUND if that season has not been ingested into the backend. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read season data, and RATE_LIMITED if the read quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: fetch_f1_team_standings
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored constructor/team standings for the specified year as a single dictionary (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if year is missing or not a valid year string, and NOT_FOUND if standings for that season are not available (for example, the season has not been ingested or standings have not been computed/refreshed). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read season data, and RATE_LIMITED if the read quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: fetch_f1_driver_standings
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored driver standings for the specified year as a single dictionary (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if year is missing or not a valid year string, and NOT_FOUND if standings for that season are not available (for example, the season has not been ingested or standings have not been computed/refreshed). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read season data, and RATE_LIMITED if the read quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: fetch_f1_race_results
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored race results for the specified year as a single dictionary (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if year is missing or not a valid year string, and NOT_FOUND if results for that season are not available (for example, the season has not been ingested or results have not been computed/refreshed). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read season data, and RATE_LIMITED if the read quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: fetch_f1_seasons
tool_schemas.description: Lists ingested seasons in the backend, optionally filtered by year and/or status. Returns a paged list ordered by year descending. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if year is not a valid year string or filters are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read season metadata, and RATE_LIMITED if the caller exceeds read quota.

year.description: Optional season year to filter by; must be parseable to an integer in [1950, 2100].

limit.description: Maximum number of seasons to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: fetch_f1_season
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single season record by year, including its ingestion status and source metadata. Returns NOT_FOUND if the season does not exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if year is missing or not a valid year string, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read season metadata, and RATE_LIMITED if the caller exceeds read quota.

year.description: Season year; must be parseable to an integer in [1950, 2100].

tool_schemas.name: upsert_f1_season
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new season record or updates an existing one for the specified year. Supports setting source metadata and moving the season through valid lifecycle states (for example pending->active, active->refreshing, refreshing->active, failed->refreshing, active->archived). Refuses invalid transitions and refuses writes when the caller is not permitted. Returns the stored season record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid year or malformed body, CONFLICT on invalid lifecycle transition, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN on insufficient permissions, and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

year.description: Season year; must be parseable to an integer in [1950, 2100].

source.description: Upstream provider identifier (for example, a feed name).

source_revision.description: Opaque upstream revision or checksum used to track refreshes.

status.description: Target season status. Transition must be valid per lifecycle.

last_synced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for when the upstream sync completed.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_f1_calendar
tool_schemas.description: Upserts the season calendar (events and session timestamps) for the specified year. Intended for ingestion/refresh workflows; callers typically set the season to refreshing before writing and back to active on completion. Refuses writes if the season is archived, or if the caller is not permitted. Returns counts of inserted/updated events. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid year or malformed payload, NOT_FOUND if the season record does not exist, CONFLICT if the season state does not allow ingestion, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN on insufficient permissions, and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

year.description: Season year; must be parseable to an integer in [1950, 2100].

events.description: List of events to upsert for the season (matched by round within the season).

round.description: Championship round number within the season.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for session timestamps.

race_start_at.description: ISO-8601 start time for the race.

qualifying_at.description: ISO-8601 start time for qualifying, if applicable.

sprint_at.description: ISO-8601 start time for the sprint, if applicable.

fp1_at.description: ISO-8601 start time for FP1, if applicable.

fp2_at.description: ISO-8601 start time for FP2, if applicable.

fp3_at.description: ISO-8601 start time for FP3, if applicable.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_f1_results_and_standings
tool_schemas.description: Upserts race classifications (race results and standings snapshots) for the specified year. Supports kinds: race_result, driver_standing, constructor_standing and setting data_status to drive lifecycle transitions (provisional<->official/amended). Refuses marking an event completed unless at least one race_result exists for that event. Intended for ingestion/refresh workflows; returns counts of inserted/updated rows. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid year or malformed payload, NOT_FOUND if the season (or referenced event/driver/constructor) is missing, CONFLICT on invalid data_status transition or invalid event completion rule, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN on insufficient permissions, and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

year.description: Season year; must be parseable to an integer in [1950, 2100].

classifications.description: Classification rows to upsert. Rows are matched by (event_id, kind, driver_id, constructor_id, standing_round) where applicable.

event_id.description: Event id for event-scoped rows (required for race_result).

driver_id.description: Driver id (required for race_result and driver_standing).

constructor_id.description: Constructor id (required for race_result and constructor_standing).

position.description: Numeric position/rank; may be omitted for non-classified entries.

position_text.description: Position as displayed by the source (e.g., 'R', 'DQ', 'NC').

points.description: Points awarded or total points for standings snapshot.

time_ms.description: Race time in milliseconds, if available.

wins.description: Wins count for standings snapshot, if available.

standing_round.description: Round number the standings snapshot corresponds to. If omitted/null, treated as 'latest' snapshot when serving.

set_event_status.description: Optional event status updates to apply in the same call.

status.description: Target event status; transition must be valid.
